docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $3,376.64 FILED BY PIRRI, ANGELO AS TO DEFENDANT CHANDLER PROPERTIES ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-18-2021 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $40) SERVED SEP-21-2021, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT CHANDLER PROPERTIES

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-18-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO DEC-29-2021 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF ANGELO PIRRI IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CHANDLER PROPERTIES IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY SAHARA SIDIQI, PROPERTY MANAGER. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $1,778.00 (COSTS INCLUDED)TO THE PLAINTIFF. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE DEC-20-2021 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: A. DATT. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS).
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) SEE SCANNED DOC. FILED BY DEFENDANT CHANDLER PROPERTIES

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE PUSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
ORDER TO DISMISS CASE WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.
